lines.text: Ms. Spellen.
You can call me Gloria.
Then call me Harry, or this gets awkward very quickly.
The collapse was triggered.
Possibly.
Someone was with him.
The report already says Ashcombe had company earlier.
At the relief.
That part is newer.
So, reopen it.
You've found questions. That's not the same thing as finding a crime.
Someone cast magic at the thing that killed him.
At Hogwarts. I can find unexplained spell residue in half the corridors before lunch.
You don't think I'm right.
I think being right early is one of the most dangerous feelings in an investigation.
If you believe the report is wrong, don't bring me suspicion.
Bring me the contradiction it can't explain.
Fine.
That sounded personal.
It is now.
Profes…. I mean Headmistress, do you know any of the people in this photo?

Why yes. They are Gideon Alderwick, Elspeth Rowan, and Benedict Hale. Gideon is an older Hogwarts historian and scholar specializing in artifacts, heraldry, and Founder-era history. Elspeth is an Ancient Runes professor and Benedict is a senior Healer at St. Mungo's. They are old friends of Professor Ashcombe.
Do you know where I can find them?
Gideon Alderwick can be found at the Restoration Workshop, Elspeth Rowan can be found at the Ancient Runes classroom, and Benedict Hale can be found at St. Mungo's hospital.
Thank you. I think I will start with Gideon first.
Any reason for choosing him first?
You said Gideon is a Hogwarts historian and specializes in artifacts. Perhaps he could tell me more about the relief and the eagle fragment I found in Professor Ashcombe's office.
A sensible place to begin. If anyone can tell you whether that relief and eagle fragment was significant to Professor Ashcombe, it would be Gideon.
Then I'll speak with him today.
Gloria.
Curiosity is one of Hogwarts' finest qualities. It has also been responsible for a remarkable number of catastrophes.
I'll try to avoid the catastrophic version.
Do.
You think Harry's right, don't you?
About which part?
That I'm chasing questions instead of facts.
I think Mr. Potter has spent most of his life learning the difference.
That's not exactly encouraging.
It is if you listen carefully. He did not tell you to stop.
No. He told me to find a contradiction.
Then find one.
Ashcombe kept this on his desk. Not family. Not colleagues. Just three friends.
Sometimes those are the people who know us best.
And sometimes they're the people hiding the most.
Let us hope, for everyone's sake, that the first explanation proves true.
Hope's never been much use in an investigation.
No. But perspective is.
I'll let you know what Gideon says.
See that you do.
